thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: HIGH — log-alert \"model-runtime-error\" fired 112 times in 5m for service=runtime-prod. First seen: 1768204321. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/model-runtime-error

olivia (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling logs & metrics now. Any known deployment?

samir (sre): Not that I'm aware of. I'm checking error signatures. Early glance: a spike of `internal_error` + KV cache misses.

jane (eng-runtime): I see a hot path in the gpt-attn kernel hitting OOM-ish traces, but nodes still up. Could be sequence length spike.

olivia (oncall): Customer impact? Marco, can you confirm if we see increased 5xx from customers?

marco (product): CS reports a handful of support tickets — mostly degraded throughput, some retries. No widespread data loss. Roughly 2-4% of requests retried in last 10m.

olivia (oncall): Ok. Triage steps: 1) Temporarily raise alert thresholds to reduce noise while we mitigate 2) Enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for bursty traffic 3) Patch log alert to avoid paging on known transient failures. I'll do 1 & 2 now.

olivia (oncall): Executed: scaled runtime-prod pool +20% capacity and enabled fallback policy: route requests with latency > 800ms to model=redwood-mini. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: action: fallback routing enabled by olivia.

samir (sre): For alert tuning — current log query is catching any `internal_error` lines. That's too broad. Suggest updating rule to match only persistent errors or known signatures. Proposed new query (Logstore syntax):

```
source:runtime-prod AND level:error
| regexp message "(KVCacheOOM|gpt-kernel-timeout|cuda-launch-failure)"
| count_over_time(5m) > 50
```

Old query was basically `source:runtime-prod AND level:error AND message:internal_error` which caught a lot of transient pings.

samir (sre): Also add a `for: 5m` condition and a suppression window of 30m after an auto-scaled mitigation to avoid alert storms.

jane (eng-runtime): I can add a signature for the transient throttle we see: logs that include `rate_limit_retryable` and a short backoff don't require paging. Example snippet to exclude:

```
- NOT regexp message "rate_limit_retryable" AND message:"internal_error"
```

olivia (oncall): Good. I'll patch the running alert to the proposed query so we stop paging on noisy traces while we observe healing. Applying now.

incident-bot: alert-update: log-alert/model-runtime-error modified by olivia at 1768204410. New filter: regexp -> (KVCacheOOM|gpt-kernel-timeout|cuda-launch-failure), for=5m, suppression=30m after scale event.

marco (product): Heads up: we should update the status page to note degraded latency for a subset of customers. I'll draft a short blurb — non-SLA impacting but visible.

olivia (oncall): Draft posted to #status-drafts, pinging CS.

jane (eng-runtime): Follow-up: I deployed a temporary guardrail in runtime to cap max sequence length to 2048 for the burst routes. Patch id: `deploy/guardrail-176820`.

samir (sre): Thanks. After the guardrail, error rate dropped ~78% in the last 6 minutes. Metrics: error_count went from 120/min -> 26/min.

olivia (oncall): Looks stable. I'm going to hand off the incident to Jane for post-incident follow-up and to write the alert rule PR. Handoff: olivia -> jane (1768204500).

jane (eng-runtime): Taking over. Immediate TODOs: 1) Create PR for permanent alert changes with regex signatures and improved thresholding, 2) Add a dashboard panel that correlates `sequence_length` distribution with `error_rate`, 3) Add a replayable eval to verify guardrail doesn't degrade outputs for median users.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook note — added step: after scaling/fallback, mute transient internal_error alerts for 30 minutes.

jane (eng-runtime): Opening ticket INF-2781 for the alert PR + regression tests. Assigning to samir for alert QA and to olivia for incident writeup.

samir (sre): For the PR I'm going to include both the positive signature list and explicit negative filters. Sample alert rule diff (text):

```
- query: source:runtime-prod AND level:error AND message:internal_error
+ query: source:runtime-prod AND level:error
+        | regexp message "(KVCacheOOM|gpt-kernel-timeout|cuda-launch-failure)"
+        | NOT regexp message "(rate_limit_retryable|transient-backoff)"
  for: 5m
  alert_threshold: 50
  post_mitigation_suppression: 30m
```

samir (sre): I'll also add a warning metric so alerts are informational when between 20-50 hits to give us early heads-up without paging.

olivia (oncall): Great. For the incident log I'll note mitigation timeline, customer impact (2-4% retries, no data loss), and follow-ups (INF-2781, dashboard panel + PR).

marco (product): Recommend we also add a dashboard widget for \"alerts suppressed by runbook\" so product can correlate mitigations to customer-reported issues.

jane (eng-runtime): Will do. Plan: PR for alert rule by EOD, dashboard by tomorrow, and postmortem doc in 48h.

olivia (oncall): Closing pager for now. If error rate creeps back up we re-open. Thanks all. :heart:

incident-bot: incident resolved (mitigated) at 1768204630. Recorded: scale up, fallback routing, guardrail deploy, alert rule update (muting noisy signatures).
